battle.name: 抗日戰爭
battle.brief: 抗日戰爭自1937年7月展開，日軍在華北與華中投入已列裝的九五式輕戰車，以短砲火力掩護步兵沿鐵路與公路推進。該車配屬裝甲中隊，在開闊地與城鎮外圍提供近距支援。

kit.name: 九五式輕戰車
kit.history: 1935年已列裝的日本輕戰車，抗日戰爭期間配屬在華地面部隊，用於步兵支援與短促機動。

countries: 1937 年七七事變後，中華民國與日本的全面衝突正式爆發。當時的中華民國政權隸屬於蔣介石領導的國民政府，軍隊以國民革命軍（NRA）為主體，總兵力估計約一百七十萬人，分散於華北、華東及華中多條防線。日本方面，帝國陸軍（IJA）在華駐軍由關東軍與華北派遣軍組成，總兵力約五十萬人，並得到海軍的火力支援。雙方在兵力規模、裝備品質與指揮結構上各有優勢與劣勢，形成了我們所熟知的長期消耗戰的基礎。
countriesEn: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident in July 1937, the full‑scale conflict between the Republic of China and the Empire of Japan officially began. The Republic of China was under the leadership of Chiang Kai‑shek’s Nationalist Government, whose armed forces, the National Revolutionary Army (NRA), numbered an estimated 1.7 million soldiers distributed across the North China, East China and Central China fronts. On the Japanese side, the Imperial Japanese Army (IJA) had about 500,000 troops stationed in China, comprised mainly of the Kwantung Army and the North China Area Army, supported by the Navy’s firepower. The disparity in troop numbers, equipment quality and command structures gave each side distinct advantages and disadvantages, laying the groundwork for a prolonged war of attrition.
people: 在這場戰役中，雙方主要指挥官的角色至關重要。中國方面，蔣介石以國民政府主席兼最高統帥身份，统筹全局；副總指揮何應欽負責協調各兵團；第5戰區司令張學良（前東北軍）在華北組織防禦；第8路軍（共產黨）的朱德、彭德懷率部在山西進行游擊；第18集團軍的李宗仁、湯恩伯則在華中指揮大兵團迎敵。日本方面，上海遠征軍司令官松井石根大將率領第3、第9、第11師團登陸寶山；華北派遣軍司令官寺內壽一大將則負責北平、天津的占領行動；參謀本部以昭和天皇的名義發布《大本營命令》，確保後勤與情報暢通。
peopleEn: The roles of the principal commanders were pivotal in this campaign. On the Chinese side, Chiang Kai‑shek served as Chairman of the National Government and Supreme Commander, coordinating overall strategy; Vice‑Commander He Yingqin handled inter‑army liaison; Zhang Xueliang, the former Northeastern Army commander, organized defenses in North China as commander of the 5th War Zone; Zhu De and Peng Dehuai led the Communist 8th Route Army in guerrilla operations in Shanxi; Li Zongren and Tang Enbo commanded the 18th Group Army in the Central China theater. For Japan, General Iwane Matsui, commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Force, directed the 3rd, 9th and 11th divisions in the landing at Baoshan; General Shunroku Hata, head of the North China Area Army, oversaw the seizure of Beiping and Tianjin; the Imperial General Staff issued “Imperial Headquarters Orders” in the name of Emperor Hirohito to ensure logistics and intelligence flow.
kits: 裝備方面，1937 年雙方軍隊使用的武器與車輛已具體可查。中國軍隊的主要步槍包括漢陽 88 式（又稱 98k）和中山 24 式，彈藥口徑為 7.92×57mm；部分精銳師配備德國製毛瑟 98k 及 7.92mm 步槍。火砲方面，國民革命軍大量使用 75mm 山炮（如 1924 年式），以及 105mm 榴彈炮（M1930），彈藥包括高爆彈、破片彈與煙霧彈。日本軍隊則以 6.5×50mmSR 有坂步槍（Type 38）為主，並逐步換裝 7.7×58mm 的 Type 99 步槍；機槍裝備包括 Type 11、Type 96 輕機槍及 Type 92 重機槍，口徑均為 6.5mm 或 7.7mm。重型火砲方面，Type 96 150mm榴彈炮與 Type 94 75mm野戰炮提供遠程壓制，炮彈以 70mm、105mm、150mm 榴彈為主。空中支援方面，日本使用三菱 A5M 戰鬥機與三菱 G3M 轟炸機，彈藥包括 20mm 機炮彈與 50kg 炸彈；中國方面則裝備少量波音 281、P‑40 等外援戰機，但數量有限，燃油與備件供應亦受限制。裝甲方面，日軍配備 Type 89 Yi‑Go 輕戰車與 Type 95 Ha‑Go 中型戰車，均使用 57mm 砲塔主炮，彈藥口徑為 57×307mmR；中國軍隊裝甲力量薄弱，主要以輕型裝甲車與改裝卡車參與機動。
kitsEn: Equipment used by both sides in 1937 can be identified from historical records. The Chinese main battle rifles included the Hanyang 88 (also known as the 98k) and the Zhongshan Model 24, chambered for the 7.92×57mm Mauser cartridge; elite units were equipped with German Mauser 98k rifles and associated 7.92mm ammunition. Artillery consisted of 75mm mountain guns (e.g., the 1924 model) and 105mm howitzers (M1930), firing high‑explosive, fragmentation and smoke shells. Japanese forces relied on the 6.5×50mmSR Arisaka rifle (Type 38) and gradually introduced the 7.7×58mm Type 99 rifle; their machine guns included the Type 11, Type 96 light machine guns and the Type 92 heavy machine gun, all in 6.5mm or 7.7mm caliber. Heavy artillery comprised the Type 96 150mm howitzer and the Type 94 75mm field gun, with shells of 70mm, 105mm and 150mm. Air support was provided by Mitsubishi A5M fighters and Mitsubishi G3M bombers, armed with 20mm cannon rounds and 50‑kg bombs; Chinese forces possessed a few foreign‑supplied fighters such as the Boeing 281 and P‑40, but in limited numbers, with constrained fuel and spare‑parts supply. In armor, the Japanese fielded the Type 89 Yi‑Go light tank and the Type 95 Ha‑Go medium tank, both equipped with a 57mm turret gun using 57×307mmR ammunition; Chinese armored capability was weak, mainly consisting of light armored cars and converted trucks for mobile operations.
tactics: 戰術運用上，雙方呈現明顯差異。中國軍隊在華北與華東的主防線採「縱深防禦」與「據點防守」相結合的策略，以城市與河流作為天然屏障，設置多層壕溝與鋼筋混凝土掩體，並在後方部署游擊隊以騷擾敵軍補給線。例如，在上海北部，國民革命軍第 88、87 師在蘇州河北岸構築連續的鋼筋混凝土堡壘，利用 75mm 山炮的間接射擊压制日軍步兵。游擊隊則在江蘇、浙江的山區設立爆破小組，使用 7.92mm 步槍與手榴彈，於夜間破壞鐵路與橋梁。日本軍隊則採用「海陸空协同」與「突破」戰術，先以海軍艦炮與航空兵轟炸摧毀防御設施，隨後以第 3、第 9 師團在寶山登陸，以重型火砲與坦克支援步兵衝鋒。日軍的「步兵突擊」講究快速佔領有利地形，並在占領後立即構築防守據點，防止敵軍反扑。此外，日軍在華北使用「分割包圍」戰術，通過快速機動作戰分割中國防線，逼迫主力退卻。整體而言，雙方在物資、指揮與情報上的差異，決定了戰術選擇的不同。
tacticsEn: The tactical approaches of the two antagonists differed markedly. The Chinese forces on the North China and East China fronts employed a strategy of “defence‑in‑depth” combined with “strongpoint defence”, using cities and rivers as natural barriers, constructing multi‑layered trenches and reinforced‑concrete shelters, and deploying guerrilla units behind the lines to harass enemy supply routes. For example, north of Shanghai the NRA’s 88th and 87th divisions built continuous reinforced‑concrete positions along the north bank of the Suzhou River, using 75mm mountain guns for indirect fire to suppress Japanese infantry. Guerrilla groups in the Jiangsu‑Zhejiang hills set up demolition teams equipped with 7.92mm rifles and grenades to sabotage railways and bridges at night. The Japanese, by contrast, used “combined‑arms joint” and “breakthrough” tactics, first employing naval gunfire and air raids to demolish defensive installations, then landing the 3rd, 9th and 11th divisions at Baoshan, supported by heavy artillery and tanks, to launch rapid infantry assaults. Japanese “infantry assault” doctrine emphasized swift seizure of key terrain and immediate fortification of captured positions to prevent counter‑attacks. In North China, the Japanese employed “encirclement‑division” tactics, using rapid mechanized moves to cut off Chinese forces, forcing the main body to retreat. Overall, the differences in material resources, command and intelligence shaped each side’s tactical choices.
data: 以下是 1937 年主要戰役的時間與兵力數據，均以可查證的史料為依據。1937 年 7 月 7 日蘆溝橋事變爆發，標誌全面侵華的開始。7 月 28 日，日軍在北平（北京）發動大規模空襲與地面進攻，迫使中國第 29 軍撤退。8 月 13 日，上海會戰正式展開，國民革命軍第 9 兵團（下轄第 3、6、14 軍）與日軍第 3、9、11 師團在虹口、寶山地區激烈交火，雙方每日消耗彈藥約 120,000 發 75mm 炮彈。9 月 22 日，日軍在杭州灣登陸，切斷上海與南京之間的鐵路交通，迫使中國軍隊在 10 月 26 日全線撤退，標誌上海陷落。11 月 12 日，日軍在南京外圍展開總攻，11 月 25 日南京城破，隨即爆發南京大屠殺。12 月 13 日，隨著日軍佔領南京，國民政府遷至武漢。1938 年 1 月 11 日，徐州會戰開始，雙方在台兒莊展開激烈的城市戰，4 月 7 日中國第 5 軍團在台兒莊取得局部勝利，斃傷日軍約 5,000 人。5 月 20 日，武漢會戰展開，雙方兵力合計超過 100 萬人，消耗彈藥達 30,000 噸，至 10 月 25 日武漢陷落為止。這些時間節點與兵力調動顯示出雙方在資源調配與後勤保障上的艱難抉擇。
dataEn: The following chronology and force data for the major campaigns of 1937 are drawn from verifiable sources. On 7 July 1937 the Marco Polo Bridge Incident ignited the conflict. On 28 July the Japanese launched large‑scale air and ground attacks on Beiping (Beijing), compelling the Chinese 29th Army to withdraw. On 13 August the Battle of Shanghai began, with the NRA’s 9th Army Group (containing the 3rd, 6th and 14th armies) confronting the Japanese 3rd, 9th and 11th divisions in the Hongkou and Baoshan sectors; both sides expended roughly 120,000 rounds of 75mm artillery ammunition per day during the first week. On 22 September Japanese forces landed at Hangzhou Bay, severing the Shanghai‑Nanjing railway and forcing the Chinese to retreat by 26 October, marking the fall of Shanghai. On 12 November the Japanese began the final assault on Nanjing; on 25 November the city fell, followed by the Nanjing Massacre. On 13 December, after occupying Nanjing, the National Government moved its capital to Wuhan. On 11 January 1938 the Battle of Xuzhou commenced, culminating in fierce urban combat at Tai’erzhuang, where on 7 April the Chinese 5th Army achieved a local victory, inflicting roughly 5,000 casualties on the Japanese. On 20 May the Battle of Wuhan opened, involving over one million troops on both sides and consuming about 30,000 tons of ammunition before Wuhan fell on 25 October. These dates and troop movements illustrate the immense logistical challenges faced by both armies.
cause: 抗日戰爭的根源可追溯至 1931 年的瀋陽事變，當時日本關東軍以鐵路爆炸為藉口侵占中國東北三省，建立了滿洲國政權。此後，日本軍部持續向北擴張，掠奪資源、拓展市場，並以「防共」為名在華北、華中增兵。1935 年《塘沽協定》與《何梅協定》使中國在華北的軍事部署受到限制，但蔣介石堅持「攘外必先安內」政策，直至 1936 年西安事變促使國共第二次合作，形成抗日民族統一戰線。1937 年七七事變的爆發，源於日軍在北京附近的蘆溝橋進行軍事演習時挑起武裝衝突，隨即雙方展開全面軍事對抗。此時日本已具備完整的工業體系與現代化的武器裝備，而中國雖有龐大人口與地理縱深，卻在軍火、彈藥與訓練上明顯落後於日本。
causeEn: The origins of the Second Sino‑Japanese War trace back to the Mukden Incident of 1931, when the Japanese Kwantung Army used a staged railway explosion as a pretext to occupy China’s three northeastern provinces and establish the puppet state of Manchukuo. thereafter, the Japanese military continued to expand northward, seizing resources and markets, and used the “anti‑Communist” rhetoric to increase its presence in North and Central China. The Tanggu and He‑Mei Agreements of 1935 restricted Chinese military deployments in the north, but Chiang Kai‑shek’s “first pacify the interior, then resist the exterior” policy persisted until the Xi’an Incident of 1936 forced a second United Front between the Nationalists and Communists, forming the National Anti‑Japanese United Front. The Marco Polo Bridge Incident of July 1937 flared when Japanese troops, conducting maneuvers near the Lugou Bridge, clashed with Chinese units, quickly escalating into full‑scale war. By this time Japan possessed a fully industrialized economy and modern weaponry, while China, despite its huge population and geographic depth, lagged significantly in arms production, ammunition supply and training.
impact: 抗日戰爭的深遠影響表現在政治、經濟與軍事多個層面。首先，戰爭加速了中國共產黨與國民黨的政治整合，抗日民族統一戰線的形成使得國共兩黨在戰後的政治格局中占據重要位置。其次，長期戰爭導致中國華北、華東的大片城鄉被破壞，農業生產下降約 30%，交通基礎設施如鐵路、公路被嚴重毀損，造成嚴重的物資匱乏與通貨膨脹。軍事上，國民革命軍在持續的消耗戰中逐漸吸收游擊戰經驗，建立了以師為單位的正規化與游擊隊相結合的混合作戰體系。對日本而言，長期對華戰爭消耗了巨額的國庫與人力，迫使日本在 1941 年發動太平洋戰爭，試圖掠取東南亞資源以補足對華戰爭的缺口，最終導致其兩線作戰的困境。整體而言，抗日戰爭成為第二次世界大戰的重要組成部分，改變了東亞及全球的戰略格局。
impactEn: The impact of the Anti‑Japanese War manifested across political, economic and military dimensions. Politically, the war accelerated the integration of the Chinese Communist Party and the Nationalist Party, with the Anti‑Japanese United Front shaping the post‑war political landscape. Economically, prolonged fighting devastated vast stretches of North and East China, reducing agricultural output by an estimated 30 % and crippling transport infrastructure such as railways and highways, leading to severe material shortages and inflation. Militarily, the NRA gradually absorbed guerrilla warfare experience, developing a hybrid force structure that combined regular division‑based operations with partisan units. For Japan, the costly China campaign drained state coffers and manpower, prompting the decision to launch the Pacific War in 1941 in hopes of acquiring Southeast Asian resources to offset the China front, ultimately leading to a two‑front war that overstretched its capabilities. In sum, the Anti‑Japanese War became a crucial component of World II, reshaping the strategic environment of East Asia and the globe.
result: 截至 1938 年底，雖然日軍在華北、華東相繼佔領了北平、天津、上海、南京、武漢等重要城市，但中國軍隊並未如日方預期般全面崩潰。中國的游擊隊在山西、山東、江蘇等根據地持續活動，對日軍的後勤線與占領區造成持續威脅。國民政府在重慶設立戰時首都，利用長江上游的天然屏障與地形優勢，維持了長期的抵抗。此後的八年抗戰中，雙方在物資、兵力與外交上形成僵持局面，直至 1945 年日本無條件投降，抗日戰爭方告結束。這場戰爭的結果顯示，縱然在技術與裝備上處於劣勢，憑藉廣袤的國土、人口與頑強的抵抗意志，仍能最終逼迫侵略者走向失敗。
resultEn: By the end of 1938, although Japanese forces had captured the major cities of Beiping, Tianjin, Shanghai, Nanjing and Wuhan, the Chinese armies did not collapse as Japan had anticipated. Chinese guerrilla forces continued to operate in bases in Shanxi, Shandong and Jiangsu, posing a persistent threat to Japanese supply lines and occupied zones. The Nationalist Government relocated the wartime capital to Chongqing, leveraging the natural barriers and terrain of the upper Yangtze to sustain long‑term resistance. In the ensuing eight years, both sides remained locked in a stalemate of material, manpower and diplomatic attrition until Japan’s unconditional surrender in 1945, which formally ended the Anti‑Japanese War. The outcome demonstrated that, despite inferior technology and equipment, a nation could ultimately compel an aggressor to fail through the advantages of vast territory, a large population and unwavering resolve.
